page.notes: The handwritten "324" at the top right is not printed and is omitted. The catchword "tione" is also not repeated in the text. The enumerators are read as i, ii, iii, iv, v, vi (printed as lowercase Roman numerals). Some of the Greek (περὶ τὸ ἐπόμενον) is copied from a small scan and should be checked. The line "Ergo sunt aliquæ traditiones nonscriptæ" is printed with no space between "non" and "scriptæ".
